policy: Aspirational or non-implemented statements are preserved as vision memory, never shipped as implemented features.

records.topic: 1B physical files
records.interpretation: Granularity Doctrine: one responsibility per module; count systems/features, not files.

records.topic: Surpass reality in quality
records.interpretation: Perceptual Superiority Doctrine: highest perceived fidelity per millisecond and per watt on the same device.

records.topic: Infinite content and quality
records.interpretation: Unbounded Architecture Rule: no artificial ceilings in registries, catalogs, LOD chains or generators.

records.topic: Legacy program numbers
records.interpretation: Historical ambition and packaging experiments; not engine features.

records.topic: Roblox hyperrealism
records.interpretation: Concrete program: PBR discipline, probe GI, temporal reconstruction, geometry virtualization, micro-detail, motion quality, spatial audio, imperfection cues.

records.topic: AAA games in days with AI
records.interpretation: Time-to-World Objective measured in hours from prompt to playable optimized world.

records.topic: Console and VR parity
records.interpretation: Device tiers exist with real budgets; full runtime parity scheduled.

records.topic: Native ARKHER text-editor surface (Round 2)
records.interpretation: Roblox offers no editable code surface to a plugin. ARKHER implements the full model side (tokenizer, symbols, diagnostics, completion, rename, metrics) in arkher/runtime/kits_studio (source kit) and arkher/code/intelligence; the pixel-level editor surface is adapter work.

records.topic: Peer-to-peer live collaboration transport
records.interpretation: The session/OT layer (presence, locks, op log, rebase) is real and transport agnostic. Roblox networking is authoritative-server only, so true P2P transport is an adapter capability, not an engine claim.

records.topic: Binary asset diff/merge
records.interpretation: Round 2 ships a complete three-way merge over structured project trees. Binary asset (mesh/texture) diffing needs a content-addressed asset pipeline, which lands with category V.

records.topic: Distributed build farm
records.interpretation: The taskgraph kit is incremental and content-hashed, which is the hard part. Distributing those tasks across machines is a platform capability, not an engine feature.

records.topic: ARKHER Studio is not a Roblox Studio plugin
records.interpretation: Standing architectural rule restated for Round 2: ARKHER Studio is ARKHER's own IDE (document/commands/selection/layout/widget/inspector/viewport). Releases/ARKHER_V1_STUDIO_PLUGIN.rbxmx is only a display adapter that lets that IDE drive a Roblox Studio session.

records.topic: GPU voxel meshing / compute-shader surface extraction
records.interpretation: Roblox exposes no compute API, so marching-cubes-class meshing cannot run on the GPU. ARKHER ships the complete CPU surface extractor (voxel kit: 6-neighbour face extraction, flood fill, histograms) and a mesh budget governed by D-O15; the GPU path is recorded as a platform capability.

records.topic: Planetary-scale unbounded terrain
records.interpretation: ARKHER terrain is tiled and unbounded by construction (tiles are created on demand and streamed), but a shipped Roblox place is bounded by device memory. The planetary streaming ledger and its paging policy are documented as intent; what ships is unbounded tiling under a measured memory budget.

records.topic: Round-tripping into Roblox native smooth-terrain voxels
records.interpretation: The Terrain Framework owns heightfields, materials, erosion, rivers and LOD meshes as engine data. Writing that data into Roblox's own Terrain voxel store (and reading it back) is adapter work, kept strictly below the abstraction line.

records.topic: Persistent cross-server world state (Modo Vida Real at platform scale)
records.interpretation: The simulation kit already keeps the world alive when unobserved through full/reduced/statistical tiers, and the state is serialisable. Persisting and reconciling that state across many Roblox servers requires the networking family and the Reality Layer original technology.

records.topic: Learned procedural style transfer
records.interpretation: Round 3 procedural generation is deterministic and grammar-based (WFC, L-systems, rule synthesiser, Poisson scatter, A* networks) precisely so that results are reproducible and debuggable. A learned component that imitates a reference style is a Singularity AI capability, not a procedural one.

records.topic: Author-written GPU shaders
records.interpretation: The platform exposes no shader authoring. ARKHER ships the entire shading model above that line: a node graph with cycle rejection, constant folding and compilation to Luau, plus a layered material resolver. The adapter maps resolved parameters onto whatever surface types exist.

records.topic: Hardware ray tracing and path-traced global illumination
records.interpretation: No ray tracing API exists on the target platform. ARKHER substitutes irradiance probe volumes encoded in SH9 with trilinear interpolation and budgeted incremental relight, which is measurable and runs on a phone.

records.topic: Convolutional and transformer models on device
records.interpretation: The inference kit is dense-layer only with real backpropagation and fixed-point quantization, which is what a mobile frame budget honestly allows. Larger architectures belong to server-side authoring tools that export quantized weights ARKHER loads at boot.

records.topic: Framebuffer-level post processing
records.interpretation: ARKHER owns exposure, ACES tonemapping, height fog and contrast-adaptive sharpening as parameter mathematics. A true fullscreen post chain requires a render target the platform does not expose to user code.

records.topic: Variable rate shading and vendor upscaling hooks (DLSS/FSR/XeSS class)
records.interpretation: Standing rule from the specification: never bolt on a vendor technology. ARKHER's own Reconstruction Framework - resolution ladder with hysteresis, edge-aware reconstruction, temporal accumulation with variance clipping and a trained scale policy - is the substitute and is fully implemented.

records.topic: Native rigid-body middleware (PhysX / Havok / Jolt class)
records.interpretation: The platform runs no native physics module a script can steer, and its own solver is not addressable, deterministic or budgetable. ARKHER owns the whole loop: fixed timestep, spatial-hash broadphase, analytic manifolds, sequential impulses with warm starting, Baumgarte correction, joints and a checksum CI asserts twice per build.

records.topic: Continuous collision detection for bullet-speed objects
records.interpretation: Conservative Minkowski-expanded sweeps solve the character and projectile cases at mobile cost. Per-shape conservative advancement against rotating convex meshes is scheduled with the mesh-collider work.

records.topic: GPU cloth, soft bodies and destruction (Blast class)
records.interpretation: Cloth, soft-body and destruction areas exist in category H with real budgeting, policy, analysis and recovery, and the constraint kit ships breakable joints and a distance-joint rope/ragdoll solver. Vertex-level cloth and fracture meshing need runtime geometry the adapter cannot generate.

records.topic: Learned motion matching (neural pose search)
records.interpretation: Classical motion matching is implemented: explicit feature vectors, weighted cost, stride-sampled k-best search inside a hard budget, hysteresis and blend-in. Compressing the database into a learned network belongs to Singularity AI (category T, Round 8) because the trainer is an authoring-time tool.

records.topic: Skeletal skinning, morph targets and facial rigs at vertex level
records.interpretation: ARKHER owns the rig - bones, poses, blending, masks, IK, ragdoll and per-distance bone budgets. Per-vertex deformation and morph targets need runtime mesh generation the platform does not expose; the adapter maps ARKHER poses onto the rig types that exist.

records.topic: Thousands of fully simulated characters at once
records.interpretation: The honest number on a phone is dozens of animated rigs. ARKHER ships five appearance tiers, a nearest-first evaluation budget, quarter-rate and frozen-pose bands and a crowd tier that skips the rig entirely. Larger populations are a world-simulation problem (category L, Round 6).

records.topic: LLM-class NPC dialogue and open-ended conversation
records.interpretation: ARKHER ships a Neural Mind Network that decides and learns at runtime (small recurrent policy, reward = wellbeing delta). Free-form language needs a hosted model of billions of parameters and per-request network calls, which no Roblox place can host. Dialogue is shipped as a behaviour and a social-consequence system (category K), not as generated prose; the language layer is a Singularity AI service boundary for round 8 (category T).

records.topic: Persistent world state continuing across servers and sessions
records.interpretation: The world simulation is fully serialisable, diffable and checksummed, so a host that can store and resume it will reproduce the exact same history from the same seed. What the platform does not provide is an always-on authoritative process; DataStore is storage, not a simulation host. ARKHER therefore ships resumable state plus catch-up integration (a region advances by elapsed time on load) and records true cross-server continuous simulation here.

records.topic: Full-fidelity simulation of every individual in the whole world
records.interpretation: Simulating every person everywhere costs orders of magnitude more than a mobile frame allows. ARKHER's answer is observer-driven fidelity: individuals where someone can perceive them, cohorts nearby, pure aggregate rates beyond, with deterministic reification that gives a re-materialised individual a plausible history and memories. The outcome a player can observe is the same; the cost is proportional to perception, not to world size.

records.topic: Per-individual economic ledgers for an entire civilisation
records.interpretation: ARKHER ships a real economy - goods, stock, production, demand, elastic price discovery and trade that moves goods and money - at market and settlement granularity, plus trade routes, taxation, laws and migration driven by prosperity. Tracking every coin of every person scales with population instead of with what is observed, so it is preserved here and enabled only for the region the player is actually inside.

records.topic: Real-time convolution reverb, HRTF binaural audio and hardware DSP
records.interpretation: ARKHER ships a real DSP chain (biquad filtering, delay, envelope following, soft clipping), a hierarchical mixer with ducking and priority voice stealing, and spatialisation with distance attenuation, panning, occlusion and doppler. Per-sample convolution against measured impulse responses and head-related transfer functions needs a DSP callback the platform does not expose. The substitute is parametric: filter-and-delay reverb per zone, occlusion filtering, and a panning law - the perceptual result at a fraction of the cost.

adopted_target.convolution_and_hrtf: recorded, requires an audio callback the platform does not provide

records.topic: GPU particle simulation with millions of particles
records.interpretation: The VFX framework simulates pooled particles on the CPU with shaped emission, analytic force fields, curl turbulence, ground collision and trails, all inside one shared global budget with four distance LOD bands. Compute-shader particle systems are not reachable from the platform, so the substitute is budget-first: quality bands that cut spawn rate and capacity with distance, a priority allocator that starves background effects before hero effects, and per-frame stepping that never exceeds the frame budget.

records.topic: Dedicated authoritative servers with rollback netcode
records.interpretation: ARKHER ships authoritative replication with interest management, delta snapshots under an MTU, a synchronised clock with jitter buffering, client prediction with reconciliation and input replay, rate guarding and lag-compensated hit validation against a recorded position history. Full rollback netcode - re-simulating the whole world several frames back every time an input arrives late - assumes a deterministic lockstep simulation and a dedicated host process. ARKHER rewinds transforms for hit validation instead, which is what a player perceives, and records full rollback here.

adopted_target.world_rollback_netcode: recorded, depends on a dedicated deterministic host

records.topic: Native platform UI with system fonts, native gestures and per-pixel effects
records.interpretation: The interface framework ships a real responsive layout solver (flex with safe areas, weights, breakpoints), a retained widget tree with property bindings, a unified input map where one action is bound to touch, gamepad and keyboard at once, tweening, theming and enforced accessibility audits (44pt targets, WCAG AA contrast). Native text shaping, OS gesture recognisers and per-pixel UI shaders are not exposed; ARKHER models gestures itself and themes with token colours the adapter can honour.
